title: OpenAI: the GPT family and the o series

videos.script: OpenAI's family is GPT, and like Google's it is read here from the sheet. {{lineup}} GPT-5 comes by version, with a mini and a nano below each full model. A newer generation, GPT-6, is sized by name: luna, sol and astra. {{reasoning}} For a while reasoning was its own line, the o series. On October the twenty-third most of it retires. Reasoning lives inside the GPT models now, as a setting on each request, from none to max. You pay for it as output. {{retire}} The same date takes most of GPT-4 with it. Model by model, not family by family. {{access}} Last, the routes. OpenAI's own, Azure's at ten per cent more for a region, and three endpoints at one address.
